yt_description:
Ever wondered if algorithms could be adorable? Meet Gnome Sort! 🍄 This surprisingly simple (and kinda cute!) sorting algorithm works like a gnome tidying up his garden. Watch how it magically sorts arrays with its unique 'step forward, step back' approach. Perfect for beginners and anyone who loves elegant code! 

What is Gnome Sort? 🤔
Gnome Sort, also known as Stupid Sort, is a simple sorting algorithm. It is similar to insertion sort, but moves elements to their proper place more slowly. It is conceptually simple, requiring no nested loops. The algorithm finds the first place where two adjacent elements are in the wrong order and swaps them. It then steps back to check if the new ordering is correct, and continues this process until the list is sorted.
